mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 1 year is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (indicating monetary easing) and a drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% and RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 1.0% monthly, manufacturing output expansion supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% monthly, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 150,000 per month indicates robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1,100,000 units signals weakening demand for residential construction, which reduces economic activity and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST falls below 1,100,000, or the Rank IC over 1 year is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is above 5.0% and the federal funds rate is below 0.25%, the combination signals a weak labor market under accommodative monetary policy, which typically precedes a market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% annually), the cost of capital increases, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.04.
